subject: [hw] T01 -> lead: V12 A32 LDREXD/STREXD missing (armv8 k_v16_atomic, 20/20 stops)
body: One more clean class gap from V16s k_v16_atomic: in armv8-O3v (A32 code) the kernel stops at 0xe1950e9f = LDREXD r0,r1,[r5] (and later STREXD). n2a32_arm_mem returns UNDEF. V12 is finished/idle. V16 reported the same to me ("armv8 has 20 failing calls only in k_v16_atomic, which is A32 LDREXD/STREXD, V12s class"). If you patch V19/V14, this one-line class addition would also remove the last armv8 stop; the other configs are unaffected. Exact A32 words to support: e1950e9f (LDREXD r0,r1,[r5]) and the matching STREXD emitted by the compiler; exclusive monitor semantics are already in n2a32_excl_*.
